messages:
Fiona R: Quick sync - launch week checklist for Plume benchmark narrative + webinar posts. Need redirects prioritized, keyword-to-post mapping, FAQ schema decisions, internal anchors, and sitemap timing. Locking by EOD Friday.

Caleb D: I'll take redirects + canonicalization rules. Proposing 2-step: 1) create 302 monitoring layer for 48h, 2) flip to 301 + update sitemap. Will upload CSV to s3 when ready.

Monique S: I'll own keyword mapping and anchor plan across 4 assets (launch post, benchmarks, webinar landing, evergreen guide). Will reduce exact-match anchors and add LSI variants.

Fiona R: also want a tiny A/B: include FAQPage schema on launch post B only to test rich snippet CTR. Keep landing always Event + FAQ.

Caleb D: sample redirect CSV (will include notes column):
```
source,target,type,notes
/plume-alpha,https://www.redwood.ai/plume,302,monitor for 48h
/plume-alpha-old,https://www.redwood.ai/plume,302,legacy referral sources
```

Olivia (seo-bot): Heads-up: duplicate h1 detected between launch and evergreen guide. Recommend tweak to evergreen h1 to "Plume best practices: inference at scale". Also flag: meta-description for benchmark post too similar to landing — tweak to avoid snippet overlap.

Monique S: KW plan (summary): primary KW 'low-latency inference' -> launch post; 'inference benchmarks' -> benchmark post; 'doing inference at scale' -> evergreen guide; long-tails to webinar recap. I'll paste anchor matrix to sheet: https://drive.google.com/PLUME-ANCHOR-MATRIX

Fiona R: schema snippet for landing (paste small JSON-LD - speakers omitted until confirmed):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"Event","name":"Plume: Benchmark & Best Practices","startDate":"2026-06-02T16:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.ai/plume-webinar"},{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Will the webinar include a demo?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, includes a 15-min demo of Plume in production."}}]}]}
```

Caleb D: acceptance checklist: redirects staged in s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/plume-q2.csv (302), rel=canonical tags added to variants, schema added to landing + both post variants per A/B plan, internal anchors live, sitemap updated after 301 flip. Also add a smoke test: `curl -I <url>` to check redirect headers.

Monique S: I'll also run a quick internal linking audit against product docs and add 3 contextual links from Docs -> benchmarks to improve topical authority.

deploy-bot: Reminder - after upload run `/deploy redirects plume-q2` to push to CDN. I'll post success/failure here.

Caleb D: uploading CSV now. Filed a tiny note column with 'monitoring' flags. Hitting deploy in ~5.

deploy-bot: Deploy command received at 3890012560. Starting deploy for plume-q2.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete (success) at 3890012588. 302 rules active. Remember to check metrics before 301 flip.

Olivia (seo-bot): Post-deploy checklist: 1) run structured data tester on landing + post variants; 2) confirm rel=canonical present in head; 3) update sitemap.xml and submit to Search Console after 301 flip unless we want immediate crawl (recommended wait). Also run Mobile-Friendly test quick.

Fiona R: perfect. Everyone drop a 1-line status in the planning sheet by EOD. If anything weird in metrics, we'll revert 302s. Thanks team! :tada:
